content:
Anna R: Quick heads-up — I ran a microbench sweep after yesterday's kernel selector tweak and there's a consistent regressive pattern on small-batch decode when paged-Flash is chosen :eyes:
Chris L: can you paste the run command + diffs? small-batch is sensitive to KV layout and launch overhead.
Anna R: ran against llama2-7b, seq=128, continuous batching on, decode small-batch heuristic set to 8. Command:
Anna R: `./bench --model llama2-7b --mode decode --seq 128 --batching continuous --small_batch_threshold 8 --kernel auto`
Anna R: baseline (flash-fused preferred): p50 42ms, p95 120ms, tokens/sec 3200
Anna R: after selector change (paged-Flash chosen for many traces): p50 68ms, p95 210ms, tokens/sec 2100
Jyoti P: that's pretty large. Any KV-cache churn in profiles? paged attention can cause extra page faults if our KV stripe heuristic mispredicts.
Anna R: yes — profile shows a spike in device memset/copy during decode warmup windows. KV pages being materialized repeatedly. Snippet from nvprof-like output:
Anna R: ```
Anna R: GPU memcpy H2D: 18MB/s (burst)
Anna R: kernel flash_paged_attn: 1.8ms (launch)
Anna R: kernel flash_fused_attn: 0.9ms (launch)
Anna R: total prefill-kv materialize: 14ms -> repeated ~3x in first 50 tokens
Anna R: ```
Marco G: so kernel choice is increasing per-request copying. Could be we fallback to paged path that isn't using async memcpy + pinned buffers.
Chris L: also check continuous batch coalescing: if decode microbatches are not coalescing due to small_batch_threshold boundary being hit, we keep paying prefill overhead per microbatch.
Jyoti P: try toggling `kv.cache_mode=lazy` and `kernel.prefill_async=true` on the same trace. If p50 drops it points to copy/async path mismatch.
Anna R: tried `kv.cache_mode=lazy` — p50 went to 48ms and tokens/sec to 2900. Significant recovery.
perf-bot: automated run summary: 2065432100-2065432120: 3 configs tested. best=flash-fused+lazy-kv (p50 40-50ms), worst=flash-paged+eager-kv (p50 68-72ms). Attached perf diff id: perf/diff/7643
Chris L: timeline hypothesis: selector change prioritized paged variants for lower memory residency, but we didn't wire up the async copy path for decode microbatch hotpath. That increases latency for small decodes.
Marco G: quick mitigation: update selector to prefer `flash-fused` for decode if microbatch_size < 6 OR if kv.cache_mode != eager. Then ship a perf test on staging for 24h.
Anna R: I'll open a tiny PR with selector tweak + a guard flag `runtime.decode_force_fused_for_small_batch=true`. Also adding a perf regression test with synthetic trace that reproduces the 3x prefill materialize.
Jyoti P: SGTM. Add an integration check that ensures `prefill_async` is enabled when `continue_batching=true` for decode. Would prevent this class of regressions.
Chris L: also log a metric on "kv_page_materialize_count" per request so we can alert if it spikes after future selector flips.
Anna R: created issue (#4567) and PR draft. Will post links when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
perf-bot: regression alert suppressed (follow-up test planned).
